chapter: The Owls and New Orleans after the war
title: Arnold Loyacano's illness and a possible new interview
summary: Souchon says Loyacano had a severe ulcer, now treated by an internist. They agree he is mentally sharp and could be interviewed again.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
